## Incident playbooks

- **I-2011-MTGOX** Mt. Gox hack (2011-09): O-KEY-COMPROMISE → O-DORMANCY → O-HIGH-RISK-EXCHANGE
- **I-2012-SILKROAD** Silk Road withdrawal exploit (James Zhong) (2012-09): O-PROTOCOL-EXPLOIT → O-DORMANCY
- **I-2016-BITFINEX** Bitfinex hack and laundering (Lichtenstein & Morgan) (2016-08-02): O-KEY-COMPROMISE → O-PEEL-CHAIN → O-DISPERSAL → O-DARKNET-AS-MIXER → O-CHAIN-HOP → O-FAKE-KYC → O-DORMANCY
- **I-2020-LUBIAN** LuBian mining-pool weak-key theft (2020-12-28): O-WEAK-KEY-SWEEP → O-DORMANCY
- **I-2021-COLONIAL** Colonial Pipeline ransomware payment (DarkSide) (2021-05-08): O-RANSOM → O-PEEL-CHAIN
- **I-2023-MILKSAD** Milk Sad (Libbitcoin Explorer bx seed) weak-entropy thefts (2023-07-12): O-WEAK-KEY-SWEEP
- **I-2024-DMM** DMM Bitcoin hack (2024-05-31): O-KEY-COMPROMISE → O-CUSTODIAL-MIXER → O-CHAIN-HOP → O-OTC-P2P
- **I-2024-GENESIS-CREDITOR** $243M social-engineering theft from a Genesis creditor (2024-08-19): O-SOCIAL-ENGINEERING → O-INSTANT-SWAP → O-PRIVACY-COIN
- **I-2025-BYBIT** Bybit hack (ETH) and conversion to BTC (2025-02-21): O-KEY-COMPROMISE → O-CHAIN-HOP → O-INSTANT-SWAP → O-DISPERSAL → O-OTC-P2P
- **I-2025-SOCIALENG-330M** $330M social-engineering theft from an elderly holder (2025-04-28): O-SOCIAL-ENGINEERING → O-PEEL-CHAIN → O-INSTANT-SWAP → O-PRIVACY-COIN
- **I-2026-COLDCARD** Coldcard Mk3 weak-seed sweeps (2026-07-30): O-WEAK-KEY-SWEEP
- **I-2026-LIQUID** Liquid Network federation peg exploit (2026-09-06): O-PROTOCOL-EXPLOIT → O-SIDECHAIN
- **I-2026-BITGET** Bitget hot-wallet breach (2026-09-24): O-KEY-COMPROMISE
